usage: The word '金色' can be used as a noun to refer to the color gold itself.
It can also function as an adjective to describe something that has a gold color.
When used as an adjective, '金色' usually comes before the noun it describes, e.g., 金色衣服 (gold-colored clothes).
It can be used in everyday contexts like describing fashion, accessories, decorations, or natural objects.
In Cantonese, '金色' is often used for both literal references to the color and figurative expressions related to wealth or quality.
